events.outcome: Provider currently states that the +372 phone-number eSIM supports calls/SMS, has no monthly bill, balance does not expire, and stays active with at least one use per year. September 2026 community users reproduced China-side signal and several verification SMS outcomes but also reported prefix-dependent failures.

data.acquisitionSummary: Provider sells a prepaid Estonian +372 phone-number eSIM online for EUR2.99 and separates phone-number lines from data-only eSIM.TF products. Upstream carrier identity is intentionally not normalized here.

keep.action: Use the phone-number line at least once per year. Provider states line balance does not expire and the number remains active with annual use; exact cheapest chargeable action is not normalized.

data.chinaActivation: Provider markets global activation/use and China coverage. September 2026 community users report activation and China-side roaming operation, including use through removable eUICC adapters, but device/adapter compatibility remains user-specific.
data.kyc: Provider public purchase/terms reviewed here do not establish a mandatory identity-document flow; do not market this as guaranteed no-KYC because upstream/legal requirements can change.
data.payment: Provider accepts major cards/digital payment methods; September 2026 community users report Alipay payment.
data.roamingSms: September 2026 Linux.do users report successful GPT, WhatsApp and Telegram SMS reception on some +372 prefixes in China, alongside reports that some prefixes initially or persistently fail selected verification messages. No platform acceptance guarantee.
data.refund: Provider refund policy limits refunds after profile download/use and excludes third-party verification-code rejection as a refund basis.
data.tariffSummary: EUR2.99 prepaid +372 phone-number eSIM; no monthly bill; provider says keep active with at least one use per year. OTP reliability is prefix/platform dependent.
guideSteps: Buy the phone-number eSIM, not the separate data-only product.
Install on a compatible eSIM device or supported adapter and verify ordinary SMS before binding important accounts.
Generate at least one line use within each 365-day period and keep an independent reminder; treat OTP acceptance as platform/prefix-specific.
